name: Breylee Acne Treatment Facial Cleanser 100g with Tea Tree Oil & Salicylc Acid
description:
Effectively combat acne with the Breylee Acne Treatment Facial Cleanser, enriched with Tea Tree Oil and Salicylic Acid. This gentle yet powerful formula is suitable for all skin types and targets multiple forms of acne, helping you achieve clear and healthy skin.

Key Benefits:

Comprehensive Acne Care: Treats facial acne, body acne, acne spots, cystic acne, hormonal acne, adult acne, and teen acne.

Safe & Gentle: Free from parabens, non-comedogenic, and suitable for all skin types.

Powerful Ingredients: Tea Tree Oil and Salicylic Acid help cleanse pores, reduce oil, and prevent breakouts.

Keep your skin fresh, clear, and acne-free with this effective daily cleanser.
